data.body: [P1] After worker startup fails, concurrent drains can all observe `_worker is None` and independently call `_pump`; a concurrent schedule can also successfully start a worker before pumping begins. These consumers may export concurrently, and one can flush and signal the shared event while another export is still blocked, causing `drain()` to return before delivery. Claim exclusive inline-pump ownership while holding `_condition`, prevent worker startup during that ownership, and make other drains wait for the owner's event. Cover this with concurrent drains and a blocked inline export.
